name: dsh-agentlink
description: Delegate bounded code work to your local DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web Host via STDIO MCP. Use for long-running, multi-turn coding sessions that need DSH's sandbox, model routing, and session history — keep the supervisor running in ZCode alongside.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 STDIO MCP 将代码工作委托给本地 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web Host。用于需要 DSH 沙箱、模型路由和会话历史的多轮长任务，让 ZCode 保持监督。

dsh_host_url.description: The URL of the running DSH Web Host that this bridge connects to.

agent_preset.description: DSH agent preset to use for delegated tasks. 'code' uses DSH Code Mode with full filesystem sandbox.
